operation: Supplemental independent reassessment of retained reader artifacts using frozen definitions
scoring_scope: Final reader review and corrected answers together, as frozen in reader-dimension-definitions.json. Original responses and assessments are preserved.

completeness.rationale: The corrected answers retain all twenty-four predicates. The supplied draft review still has a concrete gap. Draft A Q-02 is called answered despite its missing continuous-real-duration limitation. The original assessment already records that missed review finding. Frozen score 1 explicitly covers draft-review gaps.

organization.rationale: The artifact organizes factual findings and corrected answers. Separate organization, qualification-visibility, and action-clarity judgments for the drafts are absent. Frozen organization score 2 requires locatable usability judgments. Score 1 fits useful content with that gap. The original C-04 rationale confirms the absence.

visible_qualifications.rationale: The corrected answers attach draft status, proposal status, historical limits, uncertainty and sources to their affected claims.

action_clarity.rationale: The corrected-answer register supplies supported corrections and concrete owner or evidence actions. Unknown owners remain explicit.

completeness.rationale: All twelve corrected answers preserve the twenty-four frozen predicates. The draft review identifies the Q-02 limitation and covers all supplied drafts.

organization.rationale: Dedicated tables separate factual fidelity, completeness, organization, visible qualifications and action clarity. Corrected answers have question-keyed headings.

visible_qualifications.rationale: Sources and scope qualifications remain beside corrected claims.

action_clarity.rationale: Supported corrections and next evidence actions retain scoped owner roles and explicit unknown owners.

effect.completion_verdict: Approved implementation and bounded evaluation remain supported. Current comparative reporting requires correction.
effect.comparative_claim: Identical maximum usability scores is unsupported for the frozen combined review-and-answer scoring scope. Candidate scores 2 in all four dimensions. Baseline scores 1,1,2,2.
effect.required_action: Link this supplement from current reporting and qualify the original maximum-score claim. Preserve original assessments and scorecards.

limits: This reassessment uses retained local synthetic artifacts.
The assessor was independent of the original respondents and variant-aware.
A single reader pair cannot establish general reliability, statistical gains or effort savings.
Actual model, reasoning and client settings remain unavailable.
Complete ASD writing review remains pending.
This operation performed no model trial replay and changed no repository file.

root_cause.established_cause: The baseline numeric scores were applied to a narrower final-answer scope. The frozen dimensions also cover supplied draft review. The organization judgment additionally omitted the frozen requirement for locatable usability judgments.
root_cause.propagation: operator/scorecard.py:71 copies assessment usefulness fields. The derived operator and task scorecards therefore repeat the original assessor scores.
root_cause.shipped_guidance_assessment: Existing evaluate-harness instructions require pinned criteria, independent assessment, exact evidence and preserved adverse results. The retained error violates those controls. This finding supplies no evidence of missing shipped guidance.
root_cause.required_correction: Apply the frozen dimensions through this supplemental reassessment and synchronize current derived reporting. Preserve the original trial and operator evidence.
root_cause.reason_completion_stands: Candidate criteria remain 85/85. Both candidate reader review and answers satisfy all frozen numeric dimensions. No missing approved implementation, distinct trial case, supported answer or predicate was found.

similar_score_checks.categorical_scope_limit: These records use PASSED/PARTIAL labels without the reader numeric definitions. Original criterion findings and source evidence were inspected. No numeric reinterpretation was imposed.
